Can you please help me to reproduce these warnings? I would like a method to verify the correction.

I am doing:

cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug

WIRESHARK_DEBUG=1 run/tshark -r \~/shared/random-1000.pcap --log-level=noisy --log-file warnings.txt

But not getting them.

There is still the possibility of a buffer overflow in `check_fspec_validity` because of `i > table->table_size` in the code path where it is not checked. There are OSS-Fuzz bugs filed because of that.
I will make a code refactor over the weekend and try to address all listed issues (C & Python).
